stem_book: A smooth block is released at rest on a 45° incline and then slides a distance d. The time taken to slide is n times as much to slide on a rough incline than on a smooth incline. The coefficient of friction is: (a) μs = 1 − 1/n² (b) μs = √(1 − 1/n²) (c) μk = 1 − 1/n² (d) μk = √(1 − 1/n²)
work: t ∝ 1/√a: n² = g sin45/(g sin45 − μk g cos45) = 1/(1 − μk) → μk = 1 − 1/n²
